paragraphs: I am excited to apply for the Communications and Marketing Associate role at Genesis Prize Foundation. With my background in international event coordination and legal research, I believe I can make a significant contribution to your team.

My experience includes coordinating over 14 diverse community events with an average of 25 participants each, managing logistics, communications, and stakeholder liaison. Additionally, I contributed to the deployment of 'OuluBot' digital service, including data training and collecting feedback from more than 100 pilot users. My project management skills and organizational abilities align well with the requirements of this role.

I am currently pursuing Finnish supplementary law studies at the University of Lapland (OPH-recognised), which demonstrates my commitment to integrating international legal expertise with local practices. This, combined with my fluency in both English and Finnish, will enable me to effectively communicate within your team and contribute to the Foundation's mission.

I am particularly drawn to Genesis Prize Foundation's mission and believe that my skills can support your communications and marketing efforts. I am available to start as soon as possible and look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team's success.
Thank you for considering my application.
